description_en: Queries the list of sub-devices for a specified gateway device
description_zh: 调用该接口查询指定网关设备的子设备列表
name: GetThingTopo

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. On the Overview page in the IoT Platform console, you can view the ID of the current instance.

<notice>
If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no Overview page or ID is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page in the response. Maximum value: 50
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果中每页显示的记录数量。最大值不超过50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the gateway device belongs.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify DeviceName
parameters.help_zh:
网关设备所属的产品ProductKey。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入DeviceName
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The name of the gateway device.
If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
网关设备的名称。
如果传入该参数，需同时传入ProductKey
parameters.name: device_name

parameters.help_en:
The page number from which to start displaying the response.

The total number of queried data entries cannot exceed 10,000. The value of PageNo cannot exceed the number of pages that can be displayed
parameters.help_zh:
从返回结果中的第几页开始显示。

查询数据最多不能超过10,000条，PageNo值不能超过数据能显示的页数
parameters.name: page_no

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the gateway device. This is the unique identifier issued by IoT Platform for the gateway device.
If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey or DeviceName. IotId is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
网关设备ID。物联网平台为该网关设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。
如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
